FieldRelation.title: FieldRelation
FieldRelation.description: The relation an object field follows: `author` reads `author_id` → `Author.id`.

FileWrite.title: FileWrite
FileWrite.description: A model file as it was edited in Studio, to write back.

GenericForeignKey.title: GenericForeignKey
GenericForeignKey.description:
A pair of columns that names a row of any model: `content_object` is the row whose
content type is in `content_type_id` and whose key is in `object_id`.

SchemaFile.title: SchemaFile
SchemaFile.description: A module that declares models, as Studio names and shows it.

Snapshot.title: Snapshot
Snapshot.description: The schema as it was last read, or the reason there is none.

SourceBody.title: SourceBody
SourceBody.description: A model file as it is being edited.

SourcePositionBody.title: SourcePositionBody
SourcePositionBody.description: A place in a model file being edited.

TextRange.title: TextRange
TextRange.description: Character offsets into the text that was sent, end-exclusive.

Through.title: Through
Through.description:
The table Django creates for a many-to-many: its columns, the two that refer to each
side, and its indexes.
